### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** c19f8ae4d3242b498b6e47688b30e349b5522a44

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** Sub-Agent Blocker (merge automation)

#### Expected Behavior

merge-to-main.sh (-> merge-to-main-pr.sh -> wait-for-pr.sh) should merge a MERGEABLE/CLEAN PR once its governing ruleset's required checks pass.

#### Actual Behavior

PR #489 (head worktree-20260530-112200, base staged-bdd28b37f13d-1780167594) is mergeable=MERGEABLE, mergeState=CLEAN, all DETERMINISTIC checks SUCCESS (review-sub-pr, Script Tests, ShellCheck, Hook Tests, Ticket tests, Actionlint, Lint Python). But required checks 'llm-review' and 'merge-pipeline-checks' are in state SKIPPED (a consequence of commit d871396917 'ci: gate LLM reviews behind deterministic checks'). wait-for-pr.sh waited the full 3600s for those to reach a terminal SUCCESS state, then: 'ERROR: timeout (3600s) waiting for PR #489 to reach terminal state' / 'PR1 reached terminal failure state - refusing to advance to PR2'. Net: a mergeable PR1 never merges; the whole worktree->staged->main pipeline stalls.

Likely root cause: wait-for-pr / merge-pipeline treats a SKIPPED required check as non-terminal (waits for SUCCESS) rather than as a satisfied/neutral state. After the deterministic-gating change, llm-review legitimately SKIPS on many PRs, so the wait can never complete.

### 5. Skills and Workflows

Domain: CI/PR/review merge pipeline (wait-for-pr.sh, merge-to-main-pr.sh). Closely tied to the in-flight 'gate LLM reviews behind deterministic checks' work (d871396917) — may already be tracked by that effort; dup-close if so. Blocks PR #489 (external-review Finding 6) and the stacked follow-up commit c19f8ae4d3.
data.title: [merge-to-main/wait-for-pr]: SKIPPED required checks -> 1h timeout, PR never merges
